reuse.why: The moving rule is extended in the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend that every site already calls, with holidays passed through as a parameter.

duplication.why: The 'weekend or holiday' test `d.isWeekend(x) || holidays.includes(dayFromDate(x))` is pasted into getDateWithSkippedWeekend, both filters in getNextDate, getDatesInRange and getUpcomingDates instead of one shared predicate, and the daily-skip filter is now hand-written in a third place.

placement.why: The move rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the data field is threaded through parseRecurDate and RecurConfig; the daily-skip filtering stays scattered across server handlers as before.

scope.why: Besides holidays it adds a new daily weekend-skip filter with an over-fetch heuristic to getUpcomingDates, and leaves several unformatted overlong lines.

maintainability.why: Moving dates is defined once, but the skip rule and its ad-hoc look-ahead sizes (7 + n, count*2 + n, n + 2) are repeated per site and will drift.

one_place.where: the move rule changes once in getDateWithSkippedWeekend (shared/schedules.ts), but the daily skip of holidays is added separately in getNextDate, getDatesInRange and getUpcomingDates
